name: Venom Bottles
summary: In the Hinterlands, Venom Bottles fill a Witherbark village. Their great number suggests the Witherbarks value the vile green venom, and an apothecary in nearby Tarren Mill may want a sample.

sections.title: A Toxic Discovery
sections.body: Vile green venom fills bottles throughout the Witherbark village. There are many of them, suggesting the Witherbarks consider the venom important. An apothecary in Tarren Mill may want a sample to examine.

sections.title: Lydon's Verdict
sections.body: Apothecary Lydon has had no success with his experiments that day. He identifies the contents as venom drawn from some arachnoid creature, then asks where the venom came from.

faq.q: Where are the venom bottles found?
faq.answer: The bottles are found in great numbers in a Witherbark village in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Who is interested in the venom bottles?
aliases: where to turn in venom bottle
faq.answer: An apothecary in Tarren Mill may want a sample. Apothecary Lydon is the one to see.
The bottles hold vile green venom. Their great number suggests the Witherbarks value it highly.
